notes.title: Single Player Campaign In the Works!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Story Based Content[/b][/h1]
Play as the Saboteur as he begins his infiltration of the space station. Sabotage your way through several missions with the end goal of blowing up the station. You have to be careful though, as you go further into the station you will enter more secure areas. Avoid detection from the Security forces who will eliminate you if you attract attention.

[h1][b]New Gameplay Features[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*][h3]Dialogue System[/h3]
[/list]
Talk with scientists to get information on how to complete your objectives.
[list]
[*] [h3]Mission Objectives[/h3]
[/list]
Complete objectives to progress to the next mission. You need to figure out how to get past guards, locked doors and forcefields to complete your objectives.
[list]
[*] [h3]Voice Acting[/h3]
[/list]
Working towards a more cinematic experience, voice acting is an important part.

[h1]When can you expect this update?
[/h1]This update will come out one mission at a time. Can't say a specific timetable but the first mission will be out in the next couple of weeks. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Patch 1.11 Hide 'n' Sneak
notes.content:
Holiday greetings and a happy new year!
Time for a little update.

[list]
[*] Updated the Laboratory with more places for the Saboteur to hide.
[*] Made the security cameras behave more like cameras.
[*] The space station is no longer floating immovable in the stillness of space but actually rotating.

[*] Various bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
Not everyone wants to play with six other players so we have added a new small 3 player map. While the seven player experience is still the gold standard you can now enjoy the game with lesser parties.

Also made several performance optimizations.
